name: io.github.attestari/attestari
title: Attestari
description: Auditable memory for AI agents: remember across sessions, trace every fact to its source, and provably delete a user — crypto-shred plus a signed certificate and a tamper-evident audit chain.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: The MCP server lives in the `server` extra; the core package stays dependency-free.

environmentVariables.name: ATTESTARI_KEK
environmentVariables.description: Base64 32-byte root key. Set it to enable encryption at rest and cryptographic erasure (forget() destroys the subject's key and signs the certificate). Without it, forget() is a logical delete and certificates are left unsigned.

environmentVariables.name: ATTESTARI_DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Postgres DSN. Set it to use Postgres + pgvector instead of the default local SQLite file (concurrent access, indexed hybrid search).

environmentVariables.name: ATTESTARI_SQLITE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Where the default SQLite ledger lives.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Enables Claude-powered fact extraction; falls back to the built-in regex extractor when unset.
